last.verdict: Investors cheered revenue and profit that beat expectations, pushing shares to new highs.

reasons.label: Revenue beat estimates
reasons.text: Revenue rose 14% to $9.8B, versus the roughly 12% growth analysts expected.

reasons.label: Profit topped forecasts
reasons.text: Adjusted earnings of $5.31 a share beat the $5.16 forecast, up 21% from last year.

reasons.label: Services and travel strength
reasons.text: Fraud-protection and other services revenue grew 19%, and spending across borders rose 11%.

story: Growth has held steady: revenue rose 17% in Q3 2025, then 14% in Q2 2026, with profit beating forecasts. Shares slid to the mid-$470s by June, then rose about 2.5% after Q2. Stock came into this report near record highs.
